songs.name: Empathy to Apathy
songs.lyrics:
Last night I had a nightmare
It was the worst of everything that could have ever happened
You are a heart beat
Every feeling all at once
You are a nightmare

If you won't then I can't
Anything, everything
If you won't then I can't
Everything at once
If you won't then how could I?
Empathy to apathy
And you cannot find your heart amidst this dark place
You will soon become to question your reasons

Pictures leak beyond the frame to pierce nostalgia eyes
You are the burden that you wear undеrneath your skin

Stiches sewn and fracturеd skulls
Leave a psyche unmended
What's the point of being safe if you're already sorry

songs.name: My Letter to Yr Enemy
songs.lyrics:
The more that you see, the less you feel
My letter to your enemy remains unopened

Sincerely I'm sorry that there is no eternity
And if it counts for anything, a testament to our suffering
Red ink stains my letter to your enemy
Red ink stains my letter to your enemy

Shoot yourself in the foot to be humble
Shoot yourself in the foot to be humble

songs.name: Eva
songs.lyrics:
Entaii
You never came back
Dark obsessed

songs.name: Bite my Tongue
songs.lyrics:
I can't bite my tongue but I need to swallow the things outside that prevent me from doing what's right
'Cause the nights of heartache are worth almost every second that you spend alive inside, inside
We are more than the sum of our scars yet we still bear them
And I have never asked you why but it's crossed my mind more than a million times
Don't play dead or discontent
This loaded question has become your sole ammunition to justify the wrongdoings of your friends

songs.name: Destroy the Want to Pursue the Past
songs.lyrics:
If this is my last chance then how do we move on?
A calling card to call out all of my past wrongs
A form of closure wrapped in regret
Cut out the words you can't forget
Destroy the future, destroy the want to pursue the past and all it has wrought to deceive you

songs.name: Flowers For A Broken Machine
songs.lyrics:
Nothing's the same
My hands are burning away
And I can barely remember your face

An image etched Into my brain
We are in favour of closure
But it's an empty gesture
Yet this door creaks slowly closed

So much blaming ourselves for what we couldn't control
Time will errode
To go home is to acknowledge what we were
There is so much more i wanted to do for you
And nothing is the same without you

What have I become
Everything that happened was upside down
What have I foreseen
Everything wrong with me and all that was

I cannot will myself to blame you
This burden is but mine alone
Your presence once graced this earth
I'll keep that feeling forever close

Please tell me what went wrong
Please tell me it's all my fault
Knowing is half the battle
Forgetting is the rest

songs.name: Burial Etiquette - Gentle Wings
songs.lyrics:
Brittle fingers reach out to grasp
What cannot be seen against the dark
No ruin or reason will keep us apart
These pages were written on loose scraps
Searching for a conclusion
To bring this end to an end

Caught alone again with these thoughts
Maybe this time it won't be so bad
Anesthetize impure reasons
Rightfully arguing against this cycle

Nine three one
Nine three one (It's always the same)
Nine three one
Nine three one (Never going to change)

[Spoken Word]
Memory rеfers to our ability to hold in real life thе features and feelings that made up the essence of a person who has already died
The memory of a deceased person lives for as long and fully as their close enough people carefully remember
This seemingly clear banality is not as simple as it might seem at first glance
People begin to forget right away, as soon as the life leaves the body; and only a constant, every minute mental effort requiring the most careful concentration of attention, memory and imagination allows you to keep the departed among the living, as if they are still with us
A wall of glass swallowing itself into a myriad of broken reflections that I cannot repair

I am never going to know
I am never going to learn
How to be myself
Or what that even is
Searching for another conclusion
In the ashes desperate measures
In the embers of the letters
That you wrote to me

Searching for the loss we have had face to face
I draw back my hands and say goodnight
Pillars of lies built this home
Undeserving nights
I lay sleepless with question
Are you happy? Can you be
Without you sacrificing your values and dignity?
The answer is cold but true
You are frozen with fear
And unnerving recollections

songs.name: Burial Etiquette - Create Tension
songs.lyrics:
Burnt leaves in autumn ashes
Leave trails of desperate nights
And the angels will not help you
Because they have all gone blind
As the rain falls down their eyes
As the guilt makes it's way inside
An outstretched hand
Pulls the drapes behind my back
As the search grows thin
I feel the weight upon my skin
Her screams were loudest when she died
Fire walk with me
And thе angels had mirrors sunken for eyеs
Fire walk with me

songs.name: Coma Regalia - Measure The Weight
songs.lyrics: throw open the doors that trap us in this place of no growth. throw open the doors and return to where we were whole. so simple it's impossible. legs sinking in. walls closing in. mind caving in and i can't be here. i've lost something that can't be replaced and telling the difference is harder than it should be. how far have i come to throw it all away? a fool to circumstances that i should have foreseen. how far have i come to let it slip away? part of a design that never should have been and should never have to face

songs.name: Coma Regalia - To Merely Speak
songs.lyrics: mouth wired closed. eyes forced shut. drifting consciousness with no semblance of self. left with questions and choices to make. trying to find a place to put the pieces of me that never fit here. or matter. or would amount to who i'd become. what do i do with what's left. those parts of me that never fit here? i've tried to see it any other way and i've tried to be seen any other way. i've tried so hard and all i've ever done is fail. can i wake up tomorrow just this once feeling rested and ready for what the day brings? unburdened by the past and in a place where you couldn't hurt me. you couldn't tell me what i was. i could finally let go of these pieces that never fit here.

songs.name: Coma Regalia - Aesthetic Contaminant
songs.lyrics: losing yourself in losing is easy to do when all you've known is the taste of a backhand. disguised as care. or discipline. frustrated screams do nothing to erase the past. searching for something to believe in or someone to believe in me. what it costs to search through these memories. is it worth it? the price that i've had to pay. losing yourself. i'm losing everything. every day feels like the end of the struggle. disguise yourself. dress yourself in the armor of the victor but lie in silence. the hollowness eats you alive.

songs.name: Promise
songs.lyrics:
[Intro] (Taylor, Jaccob)
Have you ever seen the snow in summer?
Has the rain ever felt so cold?
Have you ever seen the snow in summer?
Has the rain ever felt so cold?

[Chorus] (Jaccob, Taylor)
Swollen lungs and raw palms (raw palms)
Grasping for my last breath (last breath)
A stuttered plea
Probably don't deserve it (deserve it)
It will not make a difference (a difference)
I counted on you for this
What a waste, oh what a waste

[Bridge] (Jaccob)
I made a promise to you
That's nothing new, nothing new
I won't give in this time
We'll make it through, make it through

[Verse] (Taylor)
I cannot feel the same
Every time we had met
A forged and forgotten tune
I would sing to you (sing to you)
Harness all that's been lost
At any cost, any cost

[Chorus] (Jaccob, Taylor)
Swollen lungs and raw palms (raw palms)
Grasping for my last breath (last breath)
A stuttered plea
Probably don't deserve it (deserve it)
It will not make a difference (a difference)
I counted on you for this
What a waste, oh what a waste

songs.name: Sword In Sanctuary
songs.lyrics:
For many years we looked after one another
Nursing broken bones and protecting each other's weaknesses
Our differences only made us stronger as a team
Our final battle to be retold through constellations

I won't sheathe
My blade in fear
I will shield you until my dying breath

And I declare, an open wound
That I prepared, that I prepared
And I declare, an open wound
And I declare
And I dеclare

I'm the one who dеcides
What my life means to me
I swore to be your sword
And I won't falter

I won't leave you here alone
Even if it costs me my life (I won't leave you here alone)
And I declare undying devotion (I won't leave you here alone)
Until the stars die out (I won't leave you here alone)

songs.name: Suspension In Timelapse
songs.lyrics:
I can't see any resemblances
to a time where we felt safe
guilty mind, guilted thoughts
are all that I have
subliminal conversations
worth more than any look
you've ever gifted

taking in the moment
everything we left
take no time
time stood still
dead air falls slowly
I cannot breathe here
all the stars are making my head clear

songs.name: Iridescent Flower
songs.lyrics:
forget the guillotine those words cut far worse
crafted amongst salt pillars an inevitable curse
try to see an honesty within your care,
a forgotten memory will always live here
I stood alone for you
bittersweet & confused
forged within a heart so cold
you should have let go
I stood alone
I stood alone for you
why did you let go?

watching you fade
from roses to frail
withering angel
dead air swallowed down
gracious minds speak sweet stories
the way your hands always get lonely
watching you fade
from roses to frail
unkempt desires
dead air swallowed down

songs.name: Funeral Charm
songs.lyrics:
hopeless disposition
all my free will
sullen, broken
wrought with despair

The right to choose

(I know you won't be sorry)

(You will not take this from me)

Their walls break me down
Into ones and zeros

songs.name: Exhaustion That Led To Collapse
songs.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Under the hum of city lights
Where months before I bid my goodnights
And hushed my truth
Heavy snow kissed my pale flesh

[Bridge]
Finding comfort in small gestures
Burdened by this sense of self

[Verse 2]
Never nothing short of heaven sent (The nocturnal everlasting that dreamt of sleep)
You saw through my 'guise (The clairvoyant that could not speak)
Before I ever could (And the exhaustion that lead to collapse)
Our images blurred into sound (Finding comfort in small gestures)
Your voicе kept me warm (Burdenеd by this sense of self)
Why couldn't I (Defined by past mistakes)

songs.name: Solace
songs.lyrics:
Finding solace in the distance
From gendered beliefs
I once held on so dearly
Out of fear of rejection, but language has set me free

Express yourself
Be yourself
Take as much time as you need

All that you
All that you

songs.name: Hyperviolent Ballet
songs.lyrics:
this time has been hard
knowing you can't reach out
the cord has been cut
long before you left
and the wires have gone dead
long before you began to live
I can barely stay awake
heavy eyes blindly guide me to this fate
make me question all that I am
and all that I was
faintly felt that hopeful bliss
while we constantly battle internal doubt
you're left to bare these routes alone
forged within myself
please come home
I said I could never want to know
but we can't even try
and I could never let go
we can't believe
this isn't what we were destined to be
so I pray and I keep
there's more than you and me

songs.name: Safe Haven
songs.lyrics:
In this safe haven we've built together
lies a little spark gently nestled in golden leaves
an enchanting little spark nestled in golden leaves
time won't take
what makes the heart change
there's more left to offer
I just can't find the words right now
searching for the answers
but I don't know how
In spring all blooms
deeply rooted within you

songs.name: Sage
songs.lyrics:
When I tried to take my life
You took me for a drive
I was sorry for making you worry
You took me by the hand
And looked me in the eye
You said this world would be so lonely without you

songs.name: Meaningful Reflection
songs.lyrics:
These days, I'm not the same
I don't know what else to say
It's just not the same
I can't recall the day it changed
It broke my heart to see my childhood self fade
Starving myself to make up for lost time
Simple pleasures seem so far away
These days, It's just not the same without you
In times of distress
I can barely recall your kindhearted traits
I hold onto your mannerisms like a mantra
I can't bear to forget
It breaks my heart to see your childhood never age
It will never bе the same
Without you

songs.name: The Guilt You Hold
songs.lyrics:
Wake from your dreams
You can't hide the past from your heart
As it digs for a meaning in the grey

Curtains open to sounds of rain
The ruin will keep the fire from fading
Never again, never again, no, I can't
On the morning, we sought clairvoyance in memory
Never again, never again, hide from lanterns light

What can I say? It's not the real thing
(All the times you've had your reasons)
Not even close, though we make it so
And what do you expect me to say?
(Who was I to make you feel that way?)
When I cannot believe that words have fallen this short

Never again, never again, no, I can't, I can't

(All the times you've had your reasons)
Not even close, though we make it so

I can't hold on to a ghost town

songs.lyrics:
Agony doesn't gift me a reason to self sacrifice

Name the stage play that made your heart crave

The red curtains close, now we're the actors
Can we stich and sew our roles convincingly or break character?

Is it too late to [?], is it too late feel?
Will I ever have a chance to return [?]

Name the stage play that made your heart crave
Sustainability in the midst of this waking hour

Pull the strings, make me move
Pull the strings, make me move
Pull the strings, make me move
Pull the strings, make me move
Gentle wings create this reason
Pull the strings, make me move
Pull the strings, make me move

A glass wall between us for so long
A glass wall of emerald ice
A glass wall between us for so long

songs.name: Cracked Lens
songs.lyrics:
I am desensitized to the fading of a light
We've been through this a million times
Dissociation is swelling up my eyes
And I have no intention of giving in tonight
Broken limbs, cracked lens & shattered ice
Misplaced my arms for splinters
A promise we wouldn't keep
A future we wouldn't hold

This thing will destroy you, let it fall
Linger here no longer, (redacted)
Shattered sight of an uneasy truth
You only see through a cracked lens

songs.name: For The Sake Of Comfort
songs.lyrics:
Ignore the guilt you hold dear
For holding onto what couldn't have been saved
You didn't give it your all
But you wholeheartedly wanted to
And that's at least worth something more

Your heart is filled with fault and mistrust
And so it aches and brews a poison
Engraving knots then spilling out your veins

Dispel the blame, I was waiting for you, in the wrong
Dispel the weight, I would welcome you as not the fire
Dispel the blame, I was waiting for you
Dispel the weight, I was waiting for, waiting for you

I write to say that I made mistakes and I know that they are real
I writе to say that I made mistakes and I know that they arе real
We can't take back all we destroyed and now we know it was real
We can't take back all we destroyed and now we know it was real

I know compassion as sinking into apathy

Leave no trace, leave no trace, leave no trace

songs.lyrics:
Water fills every gap sealed beneath the lowest forms of contact
Push and pull around my ribs
Blue orchids leave marks upon my skin
Wait for the final snap as you drift further from my grasp
Buildings shake with every breath
Grounds reform into new continents
You haven't touched, haven't settled
The bottles of letters from former lovers
You missed the most and you loved them more
Than you could ever love me anyway

songs.lyrics:
Can't wait for my final breath

A perspective gained with control
I am no longer concerned about it

I am no longer concerned about it

I have seen through the clouds
I saw the dawn break and split us in two
I thought we had to share
But it was in spite of comfort and care

I have seen through the clouds
I saw the dawn break and it split us in two
